description: The lower-humidity-variability pattern should remain screened out because the matched trajectory evidence did not satisfy the registered robustness and negative-control requirements.
mechanistic_interpretations: Reduced humidity variability may characterize an environmental context around RF events rather than act as a directional precursor.
alternative_explanations: The same context may persist before and after RF events, which would weaken temporal precedence.
The association may depend on the RF outcome definition used to identify degradation events.
Matched controls may have insufficient support in some temporal regions, making the apparent trajectory difference unstable.
falsification_tests: post_event_negative_control: require the candidate to weaken or disappear after the RF event if it is to be interpreted as a precursor.
outcome_definition_sensitivity: repeat the prespecified analysis across alternative RF event definitions.
multiplicity_controlled_retest: evaluate the full registered feature family under the same multiple-testing correction rather than selecting the favorable trajectory alone.
uncertainties: The current evidence cannot distinguish a persistent context marker from an unstable matched-control artifact.
